Thanks for the heads-up. Attaching the latest calibration rubric (calibration_rubric_v3.pdf). A few operational clarifications:

- "Ramp" notation: Employees who joined in the last 90 days should be marked as "Meets - Ramp" and excluded from the increases pool by default unless leadership explicitly approves.
- Evidence: Bring 1–2 anonymized examples per contested rating (code review outcomes, customer impact, project ownership). Avoid names in the shared sheet.
- Confidentiality: Do not forward the spreadsheet outside of the attendees. We'll treat calibration outcomes as leadership-only until release.

BrightPath HR (audit@brightpathhr.com) is copied for the record; they will perform a lightweight audit of process consistency after the cycle.

On the compensation question, Laura/Monica will confirm the mechanics — but the default is as stated above.

Best,
